[[Proximity Shield]] }} '''Endless Pain''' is a kind of Sentinel trap that can be found in [[The Lord's Labyrinth|The Eternal Labyrinth]] and end-game [[trial]], The monster apply a [[debuff]] of the same name to the player character, from its [[monster aura]] skill. Some [[Monster:Metadata/Monsters/Totems/LabyrinthPopUpTotemIncreasedDamageTakenProximityShield|variant]] also came with [[Proximity Shield]]. The trap cannot be destroyed entirely; the damaged trap will temporarily deactivated, but will re-emerge from the ground and re-activate the aura after a while. ==Abilities== {{status | name = Endless Pain | type = Debuff | description = You are taking increased damage from all sources | bonuses = 50% increased Damage taken }} * Monster aura skill known for its internal name "[[Skill:AuraIncreasedDamageTaken|Increased Damage Taken Aura]]", while apply the debuff Endless Pain: {{c|mod|50% increased Damage taken}}. * "Revive After Duration" ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|2.3.0| * The Endgame Trials and Labyrinth include a new trap type - Sentinel Traps: These traps apply one of many effects to an area and can be temporarily deactivated by dealing damage to them. }} {{Version history table end}} [[Category:Debuffs]] [[Category:Monster auras]]
